# FreeType 2.13.2 (amalgamated)

The [FreeType](https://freetype.org) font engine as one source file, from
libdragon's mkfont (vendored unchanged; GPOS kerning enabled). The converter
measures the ports' fonts with it (tools/convert/font_metrics.c). Dual
licensed; this project uses it under the FreeType License (FTL.TXT).
